cues.en: What you're looking at is one of the most precisely constructed model cities ever built.
cues.zh: 你眼前所见，是迄今为止建造得最精密的模型城市之一。

cues.en: It was made as part of HBO's new on air look and is one of over 60 visual elements that were combined to create HBO's
cues.zh: 它是为HBO全新频道包装打造的，也是构成HBO

cues.en: new program opens.
cues.zh: 新节目片头的60多个视觉元素之一。

cues.en: This film is a peek behind the scenes at how this new look was achieved.
cues.zh: 这部短片将带您一窥这一全新包装的幕后制作。

cues.en: Opening to introduce our exciting new programming,
cues.zh: 片头用以介绍我们激动人心的新节目，

cues.en: we didn't want just a sign.
cues.zh: 我们想要的不仅仅是一块招牌。

cues.en: We wanted to communicate to the viewers that when they turned on HBO, they were tuning in an entertainment center.
cues.zh: 我们想传达给观众的是：当他们打开HBO，就进入了一座娱乐中心。

cues.en: It all began with an idea at Liberty Studios in New York. We had to
cues.zh: 这一切都始于纽约Liberty Studios的一个构想。我们得

cues.en: come up with a concept
cues.zh: 想出一个概念

cues.en: that would be unique,
cues.zh: 要独一无二，

cues.en: that it would look unlike anything else on
cues.zh: 外观上要不同于

cues.en: cable or on network television.
cues.zh: 有线电视或无线电视上的任何东西。

cues.en: I took the viewer and put him in a home environment,
cues.zh: 我把观众带入家庭环境，

cues.en: and he turns on his television set, and the camera slowly pulls back and goes out his window. And magically,
cues.zh: 他打开电视机，镜头缓缓拉远，飞出窗外。神奇的是，

cues.en: we start this tour and flight
cues.zh: 我们开始了这段旅程和飞行

cues.en: as we swoop down through a city. Well, the thing was that the shoot that they're trying to do,
cues.zh: 俯冲穿过城市。问题是，他们想拍的镜头，

cues.en: they couldn't do it with an actual city. They couldn't
cues.zh: 用真实城市根本拍不了。他们没法

cues.en: run down the middle of a city with a helicopter or shoot it out of a plane or what have you. So the effect they were trying to get, they had to have a city built,
cues.zh: 坐着直升机在城中央低飞，或者从飞机上拍摄之类的。所以他们想要的效果，必须建一座城，

cues.en: a model city. We
cues.zh: 一座模型城。我们

cues.en: started off by building a cardboard mock up, and we marked off on the buildings detail or areas that we felt we would see. From there, we actually architect the building and we built it up from that.
cues.zh: 先从搭建纸板模型开始，在建筑上标出我们觉得会拍到的细节或区域。然后，我们真正设计建筑，并在此基础上搭建起来。

cues.en: Six craftsmen worked for over three months to create nearly 100 unique buildings for HBO City.
cues.zh: 六位工匠花了三个多月，为 HBO City 打造了近 100 栋独一无二的建筑。

cues.en: The models were all handcrafted
cues.zh: 这些模型全都是手工制作的

cues.en: with painstaking accuracy.
cues.zh: 每个细节都经过精心处理。

cues.en: First, they were shaped and molded,
cues.zh: 首先，他们塑形、定型，

cues.en: they were painted to look weather beaten,
cues.zh: 再把它们涂得仿佛饱经风霜，

cues.en: and finely detailed with incredible accuracy.
cues.zh: 每处细节都刻画得极为逼真。

cues.en: You really don't know how much detail to put into something like this. But
cues.zh: 你真的很难拿捏，这样的东西究竟要做得多精细。不过

cues.en: a lot of people take things for granted when they walk down the street or look into a storefront or what have you. But if there's something missing,
cues.zh: 很多人走在街上、往店铺橱窗里看，或是做别的什么时，都会觉得一切理所当然。可一旦少了什么，

cues.en: you know something's missing, but you don't know what it is. So you put as much detail in it so the eye picks up every little thing.
cues.zh: 你知道少了点什么，却说不出是什么。所以要把细节做得尽可能丰富，让人一眼就能注意到每个小地方。

cues.en: There's a working light bulb in every room in every building and headlights in the cars and buses.
cues.zh: 每栋楼里的每个房间都亮着灯泡，小汽车和大巴车的大灯也亮着。

cues.en: Foliage.
cues.zh: 植物景观。

cues.en: There
cues.zh: 这里

cues.en: are hundreds and hundreds of trees all handmade,
cues.zh: 有成百上千棵树，全都是纯手工制作，

cues.en: all different sizes and shapes.
cues.zh: 尺寸和形状各不相同。

cues.en: The model was carefully covered with a tarp so an artist could paint the 16 foot tall cyclorama that creates the illusion of twilight.
cues.zh: 模型被小心地用防水布盖好，以便艺术家绘制那幅 16 英尺高的半圆天幕，营造出暮色降临的错觉。

cues.en: The length of the model is 30 feet long, and it's actually broken up into thirds, your city, your suburbs, and your country.
cues.zh: 整个模型长达 30 英尺，实际被分成了三部分：城市、郊区和乡村。

cues.en: This would be a great place to have children come
cues.zh: 这里会是个很适合带孩子来的地方

cues.en: because it's fascinating. It's like it's better than going to a toy
cues.zh: 因为它太迷人了，简直比去玩具店还好

cues.en: Christmas time
cues.zh: 圣诞节的时候

cues.en: because this place is just filled with toys of one kind or another.
cues.zh: 因为这个地方到处都是各式各样的玩具。

cues.en: I like the way we really went into the sculpture on the buildings. We researched that a lot. We tried to see
cues.zh: 我喜欢我们在建筑雕塑上下的功夫。我们做了大量研究。我们试着去看

cues.en: the architecture
cues.zh: 那些建筑风格

cues.en: that's found
cues.zh: 那些存在于

cues.en: in many of the cities, and most of it's Victorian.
cues.zh: 许多城市里的建筑，大部分都是维多利亚式的。

cues.en: That's where we really excelled in, you know, finding the detail on the stone carvings on the buildings.
cues.zh: 那正是我们真正擅长的地方，就是找出建筑上石雕的细节。

cues.en: We threw a few extras in, seeing if people would spot them.
cues.zh: 我们还加了些额外的小细节，看看大家能不能发现。

cues.en: We put a few bums on the street, a few hookers on the corner. Those little things are like our calling card, you know, little things that we wanted to add to the monotony of the three months of building this thing.
cues.zh: 我们在街上安排了几个流浪汉，街角还有几个妓女。这些小细节就像我们的名片，你懂的，是我们想在这三个月枯燥的搭建过程中加上的一点趣味。

cues.en: While some workers were building HBO City, others were constructing the letters that formed the HBO logo.
cues.zh: 一些工人搭建 HBO 城的同时，另一些工人正在制作组成 HBO 标志的字母。

cues.en: These letters are made of brass and chrome plated.
cues.zh: 这些字母由黄铜制成，表面镀了铬。

cues.en: In the finished effect, they appear to be a giant HBO space station floating towards you.
cues.zh: 在最终的效果中，它们看起来像一个巨大的 HBO 太空站正向你漂浮过来。

cues.en: It bursts forth following the stargate effect, a special piece of animation created by David Bruce. It's actually pretty simple. You might be surprised when you see it on the table.
cues.zh: 紧接着星门效果，它喷薄而出，这是由 David Bruce 制作的一段特效动画。它其实非常简单，当你看到它在台子上的实物时可能会大吃一惊。

cues.en: It's two pieces of art. They're simply placed on top of one another and offset slowly. It gives you this this huge blast with dots that move down and out from the center of the explosion.
cues.zh: 它就是两张画稿，只是简单地叠放在一起并缓缓错开，就能呈现出这种巨大的爆炸效果，光点从爆炸中心向外、向下扩散。

cues.en: Shooting at one frame at a time, the computer will move them slowly across one another to build up the special effects that you see.
cues.zh: 计算机每次拍摄一帧，让它们缓慢交错移动，从而构建出你所看到的特效。

cues.en: The stargate effect is combined with a star field, the HBO Chrome logo, and several other components including a musical score with a 65 piece orchestra.
cues.zh: 星际之门特效与星空背景、HBO Chrome 标志以及包括65人管弦乐队配乐在内的其他几个部分结合在一起。

cues.en: Herman J. Smith, composer and producer of the music. Well, what we were trying to achieve with this particular project on HBO was that they would have the biggest,
cues.zh: 音乐作曲兼制作人 Herman J. Smith。我们这个 HBO 项目想要达到的目标，就是让他们拥有电视上最宏大、

cues.en: most exciting sound on television.
cues.zh: 最激动人心的音效。

cues.en: In other words, you can see some sitcoms that'll have kind of kind
cues.zh: 换句话说，你会看到一些情景喜剧有那种……那种开场，

cues.en: of openings and
cues.zh: 然后

cues.en: wanted all the music to reflect
cues.zh: 希望所有音乐都能体现出

cues.en: how big and enormous a project this is, twenty four hours a day programming that interests people. It isn't just movie. Another special effect enables streaks of color to race around the o in the approaching logo.
cues.zh: 这个项目有多宏大：每天二十四小时播出人们感兴趣的节目。内容不只是电影。另一种特效让彩色光带绕着即将出现的标志里的字母 o 飞驰。

cues.en: This is a special effects rig we built to put color arrays into the inside of the chrome o. Basically, what it was is a series of fiber optics built with motors and gears and pulleys so that we can change the color and also move it around. Well, you know, you can set up a camera out on the street at night, and as the cars move by, their headlights and taillights leave a long streak.
cues.zh: 这是我们搭建的一套特效装置，用来把彩色光束送进镀铬字母 o 的内部。简单来说，它由一系列光纤组成，还配有马达、齿轮和滑轮，这样我们就能改变颜色，也能让光束移动。你知道，夜里可以在街边架一台摄像机，汽车驶过时，车灯和尾灯会留下长长的光带。

cues.en: It's essentially the same effect.
cues.zh: 效果基本上是一样的。

cues.en: Reed Paul explains the smoke effect.
cues.zh: Reed Paul 解释了烟雾效果。

cues.en: Well, the smoke effect has gone through a lot of changes.
cues.zh: 其实，烟雾效果经历了很多变化。

cues.en: First time we did it, we didn't have plastic in the room, we didn't have masks,
cues.zh: 第一次做的时候，房间里没铺塑料布，我们也没戴口罩，

cues.en: we had no control over it, and it looked like a fire.
cues.zh: 完全控制不住它，看着就像着火了一样。

cues.en: And it smelled like a fire, and when we were done, we did too.
cues.zh: 闻起来也像着火了，等我们完工时，身上也全是那股味。

cues.en: What it does is it gives the model atmosphere
cues.zh: 它的作用是赋予模型空间氛围感，

cues.en: so that when you're looking down a street, a block or two blocks away isn't quite as sharp as where you are.
cues.zh: 这样当你望向街道时，一两个街区之外的景象就不会像你眼前这么清晰锐利。

cues.en: It made our mountain soft, so when you're in one part of the model, the next part, which is really five feet away, looks like it's a 100 miles away.
cues.zh: 它让我们的山变得柔软，所以当你在模型的一个部分时，下一个部分明明只有五英尺远，看起来却像在一百英里之外。

cues.en: When the model is finally photographed,
cues.zh: 当模型最终被拍摄时，

cues.en: it is done with a specially designed computer controlled camera that can perform extremely complicated moves.
cues.zh: 用的是一台特别设计的电脑控制摄像机，它能完成极其复杂的运动。

cues.en: It is filmed one frame at a time and takes up to fourteen hours to shoot a scene that lasts only twenty seconds in the finished product.
cues.zh: 它逐帧拍摄，一个在成片里只持续二十秒的场景，要花上十四个小时才能拍完。

cues.en: When you do a model sequence like this, is you shoot it with a motion control system, which was a camera motorized to make moves.
cues.zh: 像这样拍摄模型序列时，你会用运动控制系统来拍摄，也就是用电机驱动摄影机移动。

cues.en: And in the old days, you would actually have to go and hand crank everything, but now with computers,
cues.zh: 以前你得手动摇动所有设备，但现在有了电脑，

cues.en: we have them motorized,
cues.zh: 我们可以用电机驱动它们，

cues.en: and the computer actually does it.
cues.zh: 由电脑来完成操作。

cues.en: The last thing photographed is the first thing you see, the actors
cues.zh: 最后拍摄的画面，是你最先看到的：演员们

cues.en: portraying typical HBO viewers about to enjoy an HBO presentation.
cues.zh: 扮演典型的 HBO 观众，准备欣赏 HBO 节目。

cues.en: Suddenly the work, the precision, the endless hours of trial and error all seem worthwhile.
cues.zh: 瞬间，所有的心血、严苛的精度，以及数不清的试错时间，都变得无比值得。

cues.en: The HBO illusion is complete, ready to tease and tantalize your eye.
cues.zh: HBO 的视效幻象已然成型，静候挑动你的感官，震撼你的双眼。
